entities.name: PMID:25423132
observations: In C6 glioma cells treated with GDNF at 70 ng/mL, β-catenin was phosphorylated at Tyr-654 and phospho-β-catenin increased in cytoplasmic and nuclear fractions; immunocytochemistry supported nuclear translocation. The study implicated N-cadherin/Src signaling, and Src inhibition reduced the phosphorylation response.

entities.name: GDNF
observations: Glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor promoted β-catenin Tyr-654 phosphorylation and subsequent nuclear translocation in C6 glioma cells in the study PMID:25423132.

entities.name: CTNNB1
observations: β-catenin phosphorylation at Tyr-654 increased after GDNF treatment in C6 glioma cells, with increased cytoplasmic and nuclear phospho-β-catenin and reported nuclear translocation.

entities.name: C6 glioma cells
observations: Rat C6 glioma cells were the model used to test GDNF-induced β-catenin phosphorylation and nuclear localization.
